cases.name: ClosestFacility solveClosestFacility
cases.notes: Parses incidents and facilities into the canonical closest-facility request, ranks by network impedance, and materializes the closest routes through the configured IRoutingProvider.

cases.name: Route solve
cases.notes: GET query parameters and POST form parameters share one handler that parses stops, inSR/outSR, returnRoutes, returnDirections, barriers/polylineBarriers/polygonBarriers, and travelMode, delegates to the configured IRoutingProvider, and returns Esri route and directions feature sets.

cases.name: ServiceArea solveServiceArea
cases.notes: Parses facilities, defaultBreaks, inSR/outSR, travelDirection, barriers/polylineBarriers/polygonBarriers, and travelMode, validates provider-advertised travel-direction/barrier/mode support, and returns Esri saPolygons.

cases.name: LocationAllocation solveLocationAllocation
cases.notes: Implements minimize-impedance, maximize-coverage, and cutoff-required minimize-facilities over the canonical cost matrix. Minimize-facilities uses deterministic O(FÂ²D) greedy set cover with the standard H(D) approximation bound, cancellation, and configured input caps. Maximize-attendance, maximize-capacitated-coverage, maximize-market-share, and target-market-share are explicitly rejected because their required transformation, capacity, competitor, and attractiveness inputs are not modeled.

cases.name: ODCostMatrix solveODCostMatrix
cases.notes: Computes ranked origin/destination impedance cells through the canonical routing provider. esriNAODOutputNoLines preserves the cost-only fast path; esriNAODOutputStraightLines returns two-vertex polylines in outSR (the pgRouting provider batch-transforms all cells through PostGIS in one query). Providers without straight-line capability and true-shape modes return precise GeoServices 400 responses.

cases.name: barriers, polylineBarriers, polygonBarriers
cases.notes: Point, line, and polygon barriers are parsed from Esri FeatureSets and threaded into the solve; the pgRouting provider excludes the graph edges each barrier restricts (point = nearest edge, line/polygon = every intersecting edge). Providers that do not advertise a barrier kind return a GeoServices 400. Bounded by Routing:MaxBarriers. Supported on Route/solve and ServiceArea/solveServiceArea.

cases.name: travelMode
cases.notes: travelMode (bare token or Esri travel-mode object name) is validated against the selected dataset's verified travel_profiles metadata; unsupported modes return a GeoServices 400. Profile and column identifiers are validated and both impedance columns must exist. The selected forward/reverse columns drive Route, ServiceArea, ClosestFacility, OD matrix, and LocationAllocation. Existing datasets remain driving-only by default.
